## Summary
Reconciles the three proposed cross-layer function contracts from PR #130 onto the current `main` catalog baseline. This branch starts from current `main` and preserves intervening changes.

### Catalog additions
- `FN-GLOBUS-003` — OS service boundary and platform integration
- `FN-AURORA-004` — Policy-gated Neural AI orchestration
- `FN-ECO-003` — Cross-layer architecture and catalog reconciliation

### Governance and verification
- All three contracts remain `RESIDUAL` / `UNBOUND_RESIDUAL`; no implementation or verification claim is made.
- Canonical implementation ownership is unchanged; `a-townchain-ecosystem` remains the integration/compliance/evidence control plane.
- Unknown consensus/economic rules remain `BLOCKED`.
- Structural counters now match the catalog: 104 function contracts across 31 components.
- `functional_verification_performed` remains `false`; release decision remains `BLOCKED` pending source-tree reconciliation and exact-SHA Run → Job → Step → exit-code/log/artifact evidence.
- No automatic merge. Keep Draft until the catalog gate and required validation evidence are reviewed.

Replaces the diverged branch of PR #130; do not merge PR #130 in parallel.
